# 📦 Pull Request – Green Valley Theme

Thank you for contributing to Green Valley! 🌿 Please go through this checklist before submitting your PR.

## 📋 Description

Clearly describe what this PR adds or changes:

> Example: “Adds new theme variation ‘Green Valley Aurora’ with soft purple and green tones.”

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] This change follows the Green Valley color philosophy (green-based, soothing tones).
- [ ] Tested locally on VS Code.
- [ ] Theme file added to the correct folder (`themes/`).
- [ ] `package.json` updated if a new variation was added.
- [ ] Updated screenshots (if applicable).
- [ ] Design and code style matches the rest of the project.

## 🖼️ Screenshots (optional)

Please add a screenshot to preview the change if possible:

> ![preview](./images/screenshots/example.png)
